commands: ros2 pkg create --destination-directory src --build-type ament_python --license Apache-2.0 turtle_bringup --dependencies launch launch_ros turtlesim

tests.name: Final launch package build: 1 package finished
Installed package discovery with ros2 pkg prefix
Launch starts turtlesim; node disappears after Ctrl+C
Topic types verified: geometry_msgs/msg/Twist and turtlesim/msg/Pose
One-shot Twist changes turtle pose and orientation
Wrong topic: publisher present, no subscribers, unchanged pose
Corrected topic: one publisher, one subscriber, movement restored
Velocities return to zero after stopping the publisher

defect.reproducer: While turtlesim was running in domain 16, publish Twist with linear.x=1.0 and angular.z=0.5 to /cmd_vel at 1 Hz using --wait-matching-subscriptions 0. The topic had one publisher and zero subscribers. Two Pose messages were identical; the turtle did not move.
defect.root_cause: /cmd_vel and /turtle1/cmd_vel are different fully qualified topic names. The turtlesim subscriber was attached to /turtle1/cmd_vel. Matching the Twist type alone does not connect different topics.
defect.proof_after: Stop the incorrect publisher and change only the topic name to /turtle1/cmd_vel. Keep the type, payload, rate, domain and RMW unchanged. The corrected topic had one publisher and one turtlesim subscriber. Movement resumed; Pose showed linear_velocity=1.0 and angular_velocity=0.5. After Ctrl+C and a 2-second wait both velocities were zero.
